findings.detail: part 'region_air' declares face label 'inlet_tangential' but the STL inventory has no corresponding solid key — sHM will not be able to create a 'inlet_tangential' patch (V94 face-label-loss class · likely cause: CAD→STL pipeline emitted single-shell solid without face-zone metadata, e.g. cq.exporters.export without cq.Assembly face naming)
findings.suggested_fix: Re-emit the STL with explicit face naming (per-face STL via cq.Assembly + cq.Sketch.face('Tagged'), or FreeCAD MeshPart with STEP face-label sidecar), or post-process the existing mesh with topoSet + createPatch to split the parent patch into the declared 'inlet_tangential' (and siblings).
